basis: July 26, 2023 is the earliest qualifying communication I could verify. Old Dominion reported total revenue of $1,413,189,000 for the three months ended June 30, 2023, down 15.2% from $1,667,448,000 a year earlier and below the $1,584,075,600 cutoff. Both figures come from the same GAAP income statement and include LTL and other services. The earliest date remains unconfirmed because I could not verify the contents of a February investor presentation or management remarks at the May shareholder meeting.

coverage.detail: February 1, preceding earnings cycle. The release reported Q4 and full-year 2022 results. It gave no numeric Q2 2023 total-revenue outlook.
On the February 1 call, management discussed the possibility of a spring volume recovery. The available transcript gives no upper bound for Q2 2023 total revenue.
This historical index lists investor presentation slides dated February 14, 2023. I could verify the listing only. The issuer's presentations page displays a later deck.
March 3 operating update. The 2.9% year-over-year decrease was revenue per day for February.
April 26, immediately preceding earnings release. Q1 total revenue was $1,442,136,000, down 3.7% year over year. The release gave no numeric range for Q2 total revenue.
The issuer identifies the April 26 Q1 call and links its webcast. This call contained the closest earlier quarter-specific indication.

On April 26, CFO Adam Satterfield said April month-to-date revenue per day was down approximately 15% year over year. He said Q2 revenue might be roughly flat with Q1 if the environment continued without sequential improvement. Exact flatness would imply about $1.44 billion, below the cutoff, but his conditional scenario supplied no numeric high end.
The May 8 Q1 Form 10-Q put the completed April revenue-per-day decline at 13.5% year over year. That figure covers one month.

The issuer lists its May 17 annual shareholder meeting between the April and July earnings calls. The calendar supplies no linked remarks or presentation for that meeting. I could verify the event but could not establish what management said about Q2.
The conference organizer lists Old Dominion management at a May 22 client-only dinner and in May 23 one-on-one meetings. The agenda contains no public management forecast.

June 5 Q2 update. The 15.7% decline was May revenue per day versus May 2022. The quarter-to-date figures were LTL revenue per hundredweight, up 0.1% including fuel and 7.9% excluding fuel. The release gave no full-quarter total or ceiling.

The issuer archive identifies the other intervening announcements as an executive appointment, dividends, an ESG report and the June 29 notice scheduling results. It timestamps the Q2 earnings release at 7:00 a.m. EDT on July 26.
The July 26 earnings exhibit reports Q2 revenue of 1,413,189 versus 1,667,448 in thousands of dollars. The August 4 Form 10-Q subsequently reported the same amounts.

publication_date_evidence: Old Dominion’s press-release archive timestamps the verified actuals at July 26, 2023, 7:00 a.m. EDT. Its June 29 webcast notice had announced a premarket July 26 release. That timestamp establishes when the actuals became public. The unresolved historical coverage prevents certifying it as the first qualifying public communication.
